description.value: Parkhill Seafood Restaurant (陶源金閣海鮮酒家) serves fusion-style Hong Kong cuisine in Richmond, with a menu spanning dim sum, seafood, set menus, and banquet dining. Led by Head Chef Lung Chow, the kitchen blends traditional Cantonese flavors with innovative twists. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down dining experience with takeout pickup also available.
